findings.detail: The source phrase is ambiguous, but «мозг-близнец, тоже сломанный» reads as a literal twin-brain concept and adds «тоже». Avoid fixing an interpretation the source does not clearly establish; preserve the ambiguity or clarify the intended relation from the source context.
